en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a two‑storey inn or guesthouse on a tree‑lined street. The long facade has several windows and a central entrance with a hanging sign. Above the ground floor windows runs a painted signboard with German text giving the name and services of the inn, including a motor‑garage. At the bottom margin of the card is a printed caption identifying the place and building as a guesthouse called "Gasthaus zur Post" in Schmannewitz.
